The '''USV-5 Modified Landspeeder''', sometimes referred to as just the '''USV-5''', was a transport vehicle that saw some use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

[[Orrin Gault]] owned a USV-5 shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; considered a luxury vehicle for such a backwater as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], it helped Gault keep up appearances as a successful [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] despite being secretly in crippling debt to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. Gault's speeder was destroyed in a [[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] stampede.<ref name="Kenobi novel">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>

[[Hilbrun]] owned a USV-5 Modified Landspeeder named the ''[[General Dodonna]]''.<ref name="SWG:RM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Repo Man|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The USV-5 Modified Landspeeder is a vehicle in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It has been used in several locations as part of the setting but wasn't usable by players until [[2009]], when it became available as a reward in the [[:w:c:swg:Chronicles|Chronicles system]].
